name: Storm-0940 / ConnectWise Cloud Backup M365 compromise (Oct 2026)
description: Red = observed (Microsoft, Huntress, ConnectWise); orange = reported in some tenants; yellow = hunt for it (no confirmed activity). Detection IDs CW-01..CW-07 refer to detections/kql. ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1.

techniques.comment: Microsoft: ARTEX agentic AI framework used since at least September 2026.
10-14 Oct: 327 accounts, >151,000 failures, ~2,900/min peak. Detection: CW-05, CW-02.
Access to customers through the ConnectWise Cloud Backup multi-tenant app they had consented to. Detection: CW-01.
Stolen vendor app credential (client assertion) used as a trusted service principal; MFA did not apply. Detection: CW-01, CW-02.
App-only Microsoft Graph access tokens obtained in customer tenants. Detection: CW-01.
Microsoft Graph and directory reconnaissance (Microsoft). Graph reads leave little audit trail.
Apps assigned themselves directory roles (Exchange Administrator in ~50 tenants; Global Administrator in at least one). Detection: CW-03, CW-06.
New secrets/certificates added to other apps, including a security vendor's app. Detection: CW-04, CW-06.
Defender for Cloud detected bulk Key Vault secret reads via a compromised multi-tenant app (not confirmed in every tenant). Hunt: CW-07.
Hunt: Huntress saw no mail access in the tenant it reviewed; Microsoft advises reviewing mail activity.
Hunt: review forwarding and inbox rules (Microsoft, Mitiga).
